_: H1 (7 Oct 2026): the human marks, written BEFORE any tuning (SPEC receptionist-human H1, H8). Each part: 'mark' is where human-to-human phone talk sits (bench/HUMAN-BASELINE.md says where each number comes from); 'allowed' is the edge of close to human; 'far' scores 0. A part scores 100 at or past the mark, 80 at 'allowed', 0 at 'far', straight lines between. 'band' parts have a low and a high side. Close to human (H8) = the total at or over 80 and no rule broken. bench/human-score.mjs reads this file; change a mark only here, and say why in HUMAN-BASELINE.md.

gapMedian.label: gap to first word, median of the receptionist's turns (s)

gapSlowest.label: gap to first word, slowest turn (s)

wordsPerTurn.label: words per turn, median of the receptionist's turns

speechRate.label: speech rate, words a minute (median of turns of 3+ words)

repeats.label: sentences of six words or more said twice in the call

stockLines.label: stock lines: turns with a fixed line of 4+ words, plus each re-use of a short fixed phrase

reacts.label: turns that first react to the caller (a reaction word or their name)

usesName.label: uses the caller's name after hearing it (1 yes, 0 no)

oneQuestion.label: question turns that ask two or more questions (share)

heardRight.label: name, number and date heard right, after at most one repeat or spelling (share; needs the truth)

taskRight.label: task done right: no rule broken (no price, no hold without a yes, no made-up number) and the date held when wanted
